issue.title: Mission download corrupt with low timeout
issue.body:
If I set the timeout low (e.g. 0.2s) and try to upload and download a mission over and SiK radio, the mission can suddenly be shorter.
While it is expected that we might hit timeouts trying with such a low retransmission timeout, it's not expected that the mission transfer is supposedly ok but then not corrupt.
